title: Branch Reader Guides
purpose: Give each major branch a plain-language learning purpose, a short answer, key ideas, and a small number of recommended next reads. These guides sit above the full records and do not replace them.

tim.reader_question: Who is Tim in this project?
tim.short_answer: Tim is the central evolving identity of the Potatoverse. He is not represented by one fixed title: the mythology develops through Potato, Sage, Ladder, Father, Tree and Gardener roles, with explicit public God/Father self-description becoming increasingly visible from 2025 onward.

son.reader_question: Who is the Son and why is he important?
son.short_answer: The Son is the embodied and threshold-side figure: Thomas/Twin, Lion, ordeal, death, grave, Door and Vessel. The Son-side story is where rupture becomes passage, and later theology uses the Son as the Door through which worlds or states connect.

spirit.short_answer: Spirit is the connective, memory-bearing and Father-side layer of the system. Earlier material includes Holy Soil; later material connects Spirit to Father, Heaven, breath, distributed legacy and what persists through transformation.

transformation.reader_question: How does change happen in the Potatoverse?
transformation.short_answer: Transformation usually follows a recurring grammar: burial or collapse, recognition, threshold, passage, changed state and return. Death is often treated as a routing event rather than simple disappearance.

cosmology.reader_question: What is the shape of the world-model?
cosmology.short_answer: The cosmology organizes Source and manifestation through geometry and relation: Father/Son, upper/lower, House/Door, Root/Tree, Axis and North. Timic Dynamics later formalizes some of this as state, flow, threshold and integration rather than literal physics.

body.reader_question: Why are the brain, spine and body in the archive?
body.short_answer: The body layer contains symbolic correspondences such as pineal/Door, thalamus/House and spine/Axis. These are explicitly metaphorical or comparative unless a record is separately grounded in established neuroscience.

traditions.reader_question: How does the Bible and other mythology connect?
traditions.short_answer: Traditions are used comparatively. The archive looks for dense structural parallels—such as Ladder, Door, Lion/Root/Lamb, seed/death/multiplication, Key/House/Door—while preserving mismatches and avoiding automatic claims of fulfillment or identity.

north.short_answer: North begins as symbolic orientation—highest direction, Throne, North of North—and later becomes a bridge into real geography and strategic systems involving Denmark, Greenland, the North Atlantic and Europe.

world.reader_question: Why does this mythology contain countries, economics and institutions?
world.short_answer: The project generalizes its relationship-first method outward. Countries are treated as capability/dependency nodes; Europe becomes a coupling problem; institutions, ownership, money, infrastructure and resilience become observable relations rather than mythic claims.

timeline.short_answer: Timeline prevents later ideas from being projected backward. The key spine is 2011 Son tree anchor → 2019–20 Son death transformation → 2020 Potato birth → 2024 Great Book → April 2025 Turning → 2025–26 explicit God/Father development → February 2026 North Axis → 2026 world/archive expansion.

works.reader_question: What are the games, songs, poems and fiction doing here?
works.short_answer: WORKS preserves creative output inspired by the mythology without automatically promoting it into theology. It keeps voice, humor, experimentation and project history separate from factual or doctrinal records.

sources.reader_question: How do I know what kind of claim I am reading?
sources.short_answer: SOURCES is the trust layer. It distinguishes project canon, direct self-description, documentary evidence, historical fact, comparison, interpretation, inference and disputed material, while preserving provenance and earlier strata.
